content.en: Nationalization refers to the process where the government takes control of private banking institutions. In the Indian context, this was driven by the need to align banking operations with national socio-economic objectives, such as **financial inclusion**, **priority sector lending**, and reducing the concentration of economic power.

content.en: Confusing nationalized banks with all public sector banks; while all nationalized banks are public sector banks, the term specifically refers to those brought under state control through legislative acts.
